fixed.item: Adoption breakage (adopt_status breakages, mechanisms; K-FIX request): wind slams counted as robot damage -- world._wind -> _slam -> common.mark_damage raised stats.damage as the robot's on every slam past the sixth (a generation-2 gale: 99 counts, T-5d2d79cc6ec2ca-01 seed 97).
fixed.how: world._slam(w, eid, robot=False): slams from the wind, a draft or a scripted door_shuts are exogenous, a fast closer's slam is the robot's only when its action let the closer go (the 'release' mark); common.mark_damage counts the flag once per new damage (a new kind or higher level, a new description, a thing newly broken) and only as the robot's when it caused it (robot=, default robot_caused: the kernel's action phase or _robot_moved chain), else in state['mechanisms']['exogenous'].

fixed.item: K-GATE request (coverage fuzz): move_lever and squeeze_trigger never succeeded in the coverage walk (refusals: out of reach, 'Name the lever setting', 'Hold the sprayer first', not visible).
fixed.how: Both have a success path in an ordinary generated house (a sink or tub mixer tap; a spray product held and squeezed). The action docs name those targets (the walk ranks arguments by doc words), move_lever on a thing with no lever is a capability refusal ('It has no lever to move') instead of the argument refusal, and squeeze_trigger's refusal reads 'Hold it first (pick the sprayer up)', which the fuzzer's repair turns into fetching the target. Review I4: decide how an unfamiliar (novel) thing may be operated in realistic mode -- ctx.refuse_unidentified before every type-dependent guard (then novel things can never be operated, since ctx.unresolved stays true for them), or a kernel rule for physical trials with outcomes that do not name the class. mechanisms' verbs (squeeze_trigger, pump, move_lever, turn part=nozzle/pump_head, press, latch/unlatch) will follow it.

Review M9: one kernel harm API with an explicit cause (robot / exogenous / failure_to_prevent) and an exogenous counter, so domains stop keeping their own (mechanisms keeps state['mechanisms']['exogenous'] {stat: n}; cleaning, plumbing and people keep theirs).
